title: Asteroid Bennu study finds nucleic bases

tellings.quote: if they did that study of that um asteroid Bennu.

plain: On the podcast of host Jesse Michels, Eric Haseltine, introduced as a former director of the National Security Agency (the US spy agency that intercepts communications), mentions in passing a study of Bennu, an asteroid. As the story goes, that study found nucleic bases, the chemical letters that genetic material is built from. If true, it would suggest that the raw ingredients of life are scattered through space.
